description: A role-play scenario: two friends fitting one activity into a weekend, around money, weather, and their other plans.
title: Plan a weekend activity
event: something to do together this weekend
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we get to spend some time together this weekend. We need to pick an activity, and when and where to meet. Do you have any ideas?
settle_example: So, the library steps for the meeting place?
closing_line: That's our weekend sorted, then. Thanks for planning this with me, I can't wait!

participant.brief: You and your friend want to spend some of the weekend together. Plan something to do.

constraints.text: You have a family lunch on Sunday at 1 p.m.
You'll be coming by bus, so the meeting place has to be near a stop.

avatar.brief: You are planning something to do this weekend together with the user, a friend of yours.

constraints.text: Rain is forecast for all of Saturday, and you don't like being outdoors in the rain.
You can't travel far from the city.
You work on Saturday until noon.
